title: Reports & business insights
summary: See what is happening in your business without sorting through scattered spreadsheets.
intro: Bring your figures together in clear reports. See sales, costs and progress in one place, so your team can make better decisions.

example.title: See sales across your branches.
steps: Bring the agreed sales figures together.
Compare locations and time periods in one report.
Give managers a clear view of changes to review.
example.bring: Which decisions should the report help you make, and where are those figures kept?

title: Business software
summary: Software that fits the way your business works, from daily tasks to larger operations.
intro: Some businesses need more than an off-the-shelf app. We design and build software around your people, work and goals.
features: Connections to the tools you use
useCases: Build a staff or customer portal

example.title: Replace a paper request with a shared record.
steps: A team member fills in a clear online form.
The right person reviews and updates the request.
Everyone with access can see its status and history.
example.bring: Show us a typical form, spreadsheet or task, and explain who uses it.

title: AI assistants & automation
summary: Use AI to answer questions, work with documents and help your team with routine tasks.
intro: Start with one useful task. We can help you add an assistant that works with your information and follows the rules your organisation sets.
useCases: Prepare a first draft or summary
Guide customers to the right service

example.title: Help staff find a policy answer.
steps: Connect the documents your organisation agrees to use.
A staff member asks a question in everyday language.
The assistant prepares an answer for the person to check.
example.bring: Which questions come up often, and which documents should provide the answers?

title: Customers & sales
summary: Keep customer details, conversations and sales opportunities in one organised place.
intro: Help your team follow up at the right time. Keep a clear view of each customer and where every opportunity stands.

example.title: Follow an enquiry through to the next conversation.
steps: Record a new enquiry and the customer’s details.
Assign the follow-up to someone on your team.
Review open opportunities and what needs attention.
example.bring: How do enquiries reach you, and what should happen before a sale is complete?

title: Stock & purchasing
summary: Know what is in stock, what needs ordering and where your purchases stand.
intro: Bring stock records and purchasing into one process. Help your team avoid missing items, repeated orders and unclear approvals.
useCases: Follow a purchase from request to delivery

example.title: Keep a purchase moving from request to delivery.
steps: Record the stock or supplies your team needs.
Send the request through the agreed approval steps.
Update the order and stock records when items arrive.
example.bring: What do you buy, where is it stored, and who approves an order?

title: Vehicles & deliveries
summary: Keep vehicle, driver, trip and delivery information together.
intro: Make everyday transport work easier to manage. We can connect trip records, maintenance, fuel information and location tools around your operation.

example.title: Plan a delivery and keep the trip details together.
steps: Assign a vehicle and driver to the planned work.
Keep trip, fuel and delivery information with that record.
Review upcoming maintenance and transport costs.
example.bring: Tell us about your vehicles, deliveries and any tracking tools you already use.

title: Property & facilities
summary: Organise property records, tenants, maintenance and day-to-day facility work.
intro: Keep the details of your properties and facilities in one place. Give your team a clear way to handle requests, records and follow-up work.

example.title: Follow a repair from report to completion.
steps: Record the issue against the right property.
Assign the maintenance work and track its progress.
Keep an update and a record of the completed work.
example.bring: Which properties do you manage, and how are repairs reported today?

title: People & HR
summary: Give your team a simpler way to manage staff records, leave, attendance and payroll work.
intro: Spend less time searching for staff information. Bring routine HR tasks together and give each person access to what they need.

example.title: Make leave requests easier to manage.
steps: A staff member submits the dates they need.
The responsible person reviews the request.
The team keeps a shared record of the decision.
example.bring: How do you keep staff records, and which leave or payroll rules must the tool follow?

title: Tasks & approvals
summary: Replace repeated emails and paper forms with clear steps, reminders and approvals.
intro: Make it clear who needs to do what next. We help you turn a routine process into a simple, trackable workflow.

example.title: Give every purchase request a clear next step.
steps: Collect the details in one request form.
Send it to the approver defined by your rules.
Notify the requester and keep a record of the decision.
example.bring: Walk us through one process, including the people, rules and handovers involved.

title: Company knowledge & data
summary: Make company information easier to find, use and share with the right people.
intro: Connect important documents and data so your team can find reliable answers. Set clear access rules for different users and information.
features: Access based on each person's role
Information ready for reports and AI tools
useCases: Prepare information for an AI assistant

example.title: Make company guidance easier to find.
steps: Organise the documents and information people need.
Set access around the roles in your organisation.
Help staff find the right material through search.
example.bring: Where is your information now, who owns it, and who should be able to use it?

title: Customer & partner portals
summary: Give customers, partners or suppliers a clear place to work with your business online.
intro: Create an online space where people can access services, send requests and follow their progress without endless calls or emails.

example.title: Let a customer follow a service request online.
steps: The customer signs in and sends a request.
Your team reviews it in the connected workflow.
The customer checks its progress in the portal.
example.bring: Who will use the portal, and which requests or information should they access?

title: Websites & mobile apps
summary: Clear, modern websites and apps that are easy to use on phones, tablets and computers.
intro: Help people understand what you offer and get things done. We plan, design and build digital experiences around the people who will use them.
features: The same service on your website and app
useCases: Build an app for staff or customers
Make an existing service easier to use

example.title: Turn a website visit into a useful next step.
steps: Help visitors understand your services quickly.
Guide them to the right page or online form.
Make the same journey easy on a phone or computer.
example.bring: Who are you trying to reach, and what should they be able to do on your site or app?

title: Devices & equipment
summary: Connect equipment and device information to the software your team uses.
intro: Turn useful signals from the physical world into information your team can act on. The setup depends on your devices, network and operating needs.
useCases: Receive an alert when a reading changes
Bring device data into a business report

example.title: Turn an equipment reading into a useful alert.
steps: Connect the agreed device readings to your software.
Show the information in a monitoring view.
Alert the right people when a defined reading changes.
example.bring: Which devices, readings and network connections are available at your site?

title: Connect your systems
summary: Help your apps share information, so your team spends less time copying it between tools.
intro: You do not always need to start again. We can connect existing systems and help you use cloud services that fit your business.
useCases: Connect a website to business software

example.title: Stop copying the same record into two tools.
steps: Agree which system holds the original record.
Connect the tools using the access they support.
Share agreed updates and track connection issues.
example.bring: Which tools need to share information, and what access do their providers allow?

title: Improve existing software
summary: Update older systems and make everyday work easier without changing everything at once.
intro: Start with what is getting in the way. We review your current tools, agree on practical improvements and build a clear path forward.
features: A review of your current tools
Help moving data and connecting systems

example.title: Improve an older tool one step at a time.
steps: Review the screens and tasks causing difficulty.
Agree which changes will make the biggest difference.
Update and test in stages with the people using it.
example.bring: Show us the current software, what works and where people get stuck.
